rounds.brief: A library app: a member reserves a book, is told when it is ready, and can cancel.

constraint.text: The user must be able to undo the last action for 30 seconds.

rounds.constraintCheck: Every action that takes effect leads to a state that offers Undo for at least 30 seconds.
rounds.changed: Reserving and cancelling now show Undo for 30 seconds. The confirmation dialog before cancelling is gone: Undo protects the user better, with one step fewer.

failures: book > reserved: reserved offers no Undo for 30 seconds
book > reserved: no Undo transition leaves reserved
cancel-dialog > cancelled: cancelled offers no Undo for 30 seconds
cancel-dialog > cancelled: no Undo transition leaves cancelled

rounds.brief: A tool-lending shelf for neighbours: borrow a drill, return it, report it broken.

constraint.text: A second person (a parent, a manager) must approve before the action takes effect.

rounds.constraintCheck: Every action that takes effect waits for a second person, who can approve or decline, and the approved state is entered only after that wait.
rounds.changed: Borrow becomes Ask to borrow. A new waiting screen holds the request until the shelf keeper approves or declines it, and the borrower can withdraw it; the loan starts only after approval.

failures: tool > borrowed: takes effect at once; no state waits for a second person

rounds.brief: A class trip form: a parent gives permission, pays, and can change their answer.

constraint.text: The user may lose their connection at any step; nothing they typed may be lost.

rounds.constraintCheck: Every state with a field has an offline state that keeps each field and its value, with a way back or on once the connection returns.
rounds.changed: Each screen with a field gets an offline state that shows the answers kept on the device and a way on once the connection is back: Try again sends them, Back returns to the form.

failures: permission: no offline state; what was typed would be lost
pay: no offline state; what was typed would be lost

rounds.brief: A tool-lending shelf for neighbours: borrow a drill, return it, report it broken.

constraint.text: Every screen must work with a keyboard only, and the order of focus must match the order of reading. Half the users read English as a second language; no screen may have more than one action.

rounds.constraintCheck: On every screen, focus moves through the controls in the order a reader meets them (top to bottom, then left to right), and no screen has more than one action (a control that takes effect). Checked here from the layout of each state, and in a browser, which walks every screen with the Tab key.
rounds.changed: This round plays the two screen cards together, because one walk through the screens checks both. Borrow moved from the top right corner to beside the date, so focus reaches it after the date, where a reader does. The loan screen kept one action, Return it; reporting a broken tool moved to its own screen, reached by a link, with one action of its own.

failures: tool: focus goes Return by, Borrow, Back to the shelf; reading goes Borrow, Return by, Back to the shelf
borrowed: 2 actions (Return it, Report it broken)
